reason: Fallen wood suggests shelter for small animals, but I do not yet know how to create the mammal lineage, so checking its partners may help.

effect: Fallen wood combined with limbed vertebrates to produce small furred animals, completing the forest goal and the chapter.
reaction: The shelter connection was clearer after the result, and the hint of a great impact makes me curious.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making limbed vertebrates was worthwhile: the water's-edge setting connected the transition to inherited changes without implying that fish chose to grow legs.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting reptiles only listed two partners, so it felt less informative on its own than the subsequent combinations.

surprise.text: Fallen wood led directly from limbed vertebrates to small furred animals; I had expected to need a separate mammal lineage first.

arbitrary.text: Air producing birds from reptiles was a rather compressed leap, even though the result explained their dinosaur lineage.

continue.text: Yes. The forest animals' effects on their habitat and the mention of a future impact make me curious how the world changes next.
